Set up Telegram

  1. Open BotFather in Telegram and send /newbot. Choose a name and username for your team's bot. Open BotFather

  2. Put the Telegram bot token in the settings file, as shown below, and apply the settings file. MMHotline checks the token with Telegram before saving the token. To replace a revoked token, use the new token for the existing bot.

  3. Connect your own Telegram chat under Contact methods. Saving the contact method sends a test message.

Settings file keys

  • Telegram bot token

    sending_services.telegram.bot_token

    The token BotFather gives you.

Example settings

sending_services:
  telegram:
    bot_token: <Telegram bot token>
Where Telegram is set up

Set in TEMPORARY-DIRECTORY/mmhotline_settings.yml, in sending_services.telegram. The file's first line says: Managed by MMX from mmhotline_settings.yml in the systems repository. Change it there and push; util01 applies it.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
